newsitem.title: USA: Worldtalk foresees Q1 EPS loss.
newsitem.headline: Worldtalk foresees Q1 EPS loss.

text.p: Worldtalk Corp said Wednesday it expected to report a net loss ranging between $0.15 a share and $0.19 a share for the first quarter due to market changes.
For the same period a year ago, the company reported a net loss of $0.08 a share, it said.
The company said its revenues would likely total between $2.6 million and $2.9 million for the period ended March 31 compared to $2.7 million for the same quarter last year.
It said the figures were a result of the lower than anticipated direct sales of its UNIX-based products.
UNIX is an operating system for mainframe computers.
Describing the figures as preliminary, it said it planned to release them on April 23.
Worldtalk provides software products to help companies organize their computer networks including electronic mail and directories.
